pages.title: Prowler
pages.text: The Prowler. This one seems to be just like the Warp

but they seem to have found themselves in a different plane of existence that is different from their predecessors. Why or how this is, is unclear to me. $(br)$(br) Their colors are really bright and their body, rather than being smooth-appearing as the Warps, is riddled with what appear to be scales, some kind of evolution? $(br)$(br) Their diet is still the same it seems, eating from tree leaves, watching them reach for a handful of leaves and gnashing them down instantaneously is kind of humoring, but of course it's only funny until they realize you've been watching them and make a mad dash at you with the intent to kill.
